scripts.build: npm run version:check && npm run build -w @openworkgraph/protocol && npm run build -w @openworkgraph/agent-service
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @openworkgraph/protocol && npm run typecheck -w @openworkgraph/agent-service
scripts.test: npm run test:versions && npm run build && npm run test -w @openworkgraph/agent-service
scripts.dev:service: npm run build && npm run start -w @openworkgraph/agent-service --
scripts.build:web: npm run version:check && npm --prefix web-client run build
